Transparent words

The rule

A transparent word is the same word in French and in English. Same spelling, or nearly, and the same meaning: important, international, condition, danger, simple.

Put the accent on the tonic syllable

2 · The seven worst offenders

These seven are mangled on a sound rather than on the stress. Every one of them is a sound that has a whole lesson of its own.

countryThe ou is the vowel in cut, not oo. KUN-tree
heroThe h is breathed. Drop it and the word is gone. HEER-oh
mythEnds in the quiet th, not a t. MITH
authorThe quiet th again, and an -or that lands on nothing. AW-thuh
firmThe ir is not ee, and there is no r sound. FURM
languageA hidden double-u in the gu, and a short i at the end. LANG-gwij
messageSame ending as language. MESS-ij

3 · Names are transparent words too

Tap to hear, then say each one with the English beat.

Paris Texas Berlin Hong Kong Canada Amsterdam

ParisPARR-iss, with an s on the end, and the accent at the front.
Berlinbur-LIN, accent at the back.
CanadaCAN-uh-duh. One syllable said, two thrown away.
AmsterdamAM-stuh-dam. The middle syllable goes to nothing, same as every -er in the language.

Same for people: Harry Potter is HARR-ee POTT-uh, and both surnames in Julia Roberts and Brad Pitt keep their accent at the front.
